Summary: Refactoring the existing methods as part of drop-counters testcase to be reused in measuring drops in dualtor testcases.
Fixes # https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/2817

### Type of change

<!--
- Fill x for your type of change.
- e.g.
- [x] Bug fix
-->

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
Move the useful methods already present as part of drop-counter test to helpers dir. This is done so that these methods can now be used by other tests, such as dualtor testcases which require drop measurements.

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Support dualtor testing.

#### How did you do it?

#### How did you verify/test it?
Tested with a sample test:

```Python
def try_neighbor_flush(duthost):

    cmd_list = ["intfstat -D", "sonic-clear counters"]
    duthost.shell_cmds(cmds=cmd_list)

    logger.info("Output of L2 before: {}".format(get_pkt_drops(duthost, GET_L2_COUNTERS, None)))
    time.sleep(1)
    neigh_flush = duthost.shell("ip -4 neigh del 192.168.0.2 dev Vlan1000", module_ignore_errors=True)['stdout']
    logger.info("Output of action: {}".format(neigh_flush))
    time.sleep(5)
    logger.info("Output of L2 after: {}".format(get_pkt_drops(duthost, GET_L2_COUNTERS, None)))


def test_t1_to_server_active_tor_neigh_flush(duthosts,send_t1_to_server_after_action):
    active_host_before = duthosts[1]
    logger.info("Active ToR before {}".format(active_host_before.hostname))

    # perform bgp shutdown on active TOR
    send_t1_to_server_after_action(active_host_before,
                                action = lambda: try_neighbor_flush(active_host_before))
